pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with moderate edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients transitioning to light corridors. Patch area is largest on the mid-flank and decreases in scale towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected topological graph of light-toned pathways. Primary nodes consist of three-way intersections forming a continuous lattice. Pixel thickness of pathways is consistent across the lateral view.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with low-amplitude peaks and high-frequency serrations visible against the out-of-focus background.
